text:
GENERATE BURST T2P-run-NW — Run C-9 pipeline test T2 (Matt R-C9-62, per-frame paint in all eight directions R-C9-66): PAINT-OVER of the 3D manticore, run, facing AWAY to the viewer's UPPER LEFT (north-west), on one sheet. task_id "T2P-run-NW".

IMAGE 1 is a SPRITE SHEET: 8 animation frames of ONE RUN CYCLE (a low, fast gallop) of a four-legged creature facing AWAY to the viewer's UPPER LEFT (north-west), rear three-quarter view, in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), each frame centred in its own cell of a 4x3 grid on flat pure #00ff00; the THIRD ROW is EMPTY green and must stay empty. The frames are renders of a 3D model: their POSES, OUTLINES, POSITIONS and SIZES are correct, but their surface is flat and plastic.
IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED character sheet of this creature, the MANTICORE (four views: top-left front, top-right its right side facing the viewer's right, bottom-left back, bottom-right its left side facing the viewer's left): its lean hound body with ribs showing, blue-grey hide with a darker spine and paler belly, clawed paws, the long whip tail, and the calm bearded, long-haired face of a MAN with a mane around it; and the painter's hand (dark ink line, hatching, transparent washes). IMAGE 3 is the 13th-century bestiary page it comes from: the face and the uncanny calm to keep.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet in which EVERY figure is repainted as the manticore of IMAGE 2 seen from that direction, in EXACTLY that frame's pose, outline, position and size: same place in its cell, same leg, tail and head angles, paws on the same spots. Paint every frame as ONE consistent creature in ONE consistent hand: the same hide, markings, mane and colours in every frame (this is an animation: any change between frames will flicker).
Keep the 4x3 grid exactly as laid out: no frame added, removed, merged or reordered, no cell borders, no text, no ground shadows.

BACKGROUND: keep the background flat pure #00ff00, as in IMAGE 1. If the image model returns a darker or gradient background anyway, DO NOT spend a retry on it and still deliver the image: the figures are cut out afterwards by their exact 3D outlines, so the background colour does not decide success. Spend retries ONLY on the faults named below.

HEAD (the most important instruction; earlier sheets painted faces onto heads turned away): the head is turned mostly AWAY from the viewer. Paint the BACK and SIDE of the head: the long hair and the mane, with at most a sliver of cheek and the edge of the beard at the side, exactly as far as IMAGE 1 shows skin. NOT a face: no eye, no nose, no mouth. Paint skin ONLY where IMAGE 1 shows skin: the render's own colours show exactly where the face is.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 2: copy its hand; do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if a frame's pose, facing or position changed, a frame is missing or duplicated, the creature differs between frames, or a face is painted where IMAGE 1 shows the head turned away — name the reason. Never retry for the background colour. Copy outputs to out/T2P-run-NW_a.png and out/T2P-run-NW_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "T2P-run-NW"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the sheet to EDIT (8 animation frames of the Meshy 3D manticore, NW; poses correct, surface flat)
IMAGE 2 — the approved four-view character sheet of the manticore (look, markings, face, hand)
IMAGE 3 — the bestiary source (Rochester Bestiary, c.1230, public domain): the face and its calm
